test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Garima walked 15 m towards the north and then turned to the right and walked 20 m. She further turned to the left and walked 5 m. Finally, she turned to the left again and walked 20 m. How many metres was she from the starting point and in which direction? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b10e81ee78798b2e3f12699db2be39b92b4598eef0fa778efdd8a814d1f4111e.png] 

Distance between starting and ending point = 15 + 5 = 20 m.

Now, she is **20 m** from the starting point and in North direction.

Hence, the correct answer is "**20 m, North**".
